data.title: Malta
data.about:
Introducing the latest cluster launched in Lagoons by Damac. 

This is Malta. Inspired by the beautiful waterfront lifestyle of Malta, this cluster offers you a choice of 4 and 5 bedroom townhouses. They are all beatifully crafter and prices start at AED 1.75 million. Choose this perfect coastal life in Dubai.

location_tile.title: Malta Cluster Is Nestled Within Lagoons by Damac.
location_tile.heading: location
location_tile.description:
It is just a few minutes drive from major city attractions and is located between Emirates Road and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road. It is right opposite Damac Hills.

  • 10 mins – Damac Hills | Dubai Autodrome
  • 12 mins – Dubai Polo & Equestrian Club | Dubai Sports City
  • 22 mins – Dubai Marina
  • 35 mins – Dubai International Airport
